title: Clean typewell-horizontal GR candidate bank
hypothesis: Test-available horizontal and typewell GR can identify a bounded TVT path correction that improves both last-known TVT and the exact E004 geometry-prefix comparator under repeated whole-well suffix validation without increasing tail risk.

forbidden_inputs: external inferred labels or opaque artifacts
design.promotion: An eligible candidate must improve pooled RMSE by at least 0.35 versus last-known and 0.10 versus E004, win at least four of five repeated maps, deteriorate p90 by no more than 0.50 ft and worst-5% SSE share by no more than 0.01 versus either comparator, retain positive gains under both spatial and typewell-cluster stress, pass shuffled/duplicate/no-GR/runtime/memory controls, and satisfy the pre-registered diversity condition.
design.deployment: Kaggle packaging and private internet-disabled parity are authorized only after all statistical promotion gates pass. A deployment-ready candidate must also reconstruct exact sample IDs/order with finite values and preserve no-GR fallback behavior.
